senses.en: the act of making something holy

example.en: The ceremony included the sanctification of the new church building.
example.zh: 仪式包括为新教堂建筑举行祝圣。

senses.en: not allowing sound to pass through

example.en: The studio has soundproof walls.
example.zh: 录音室装有隔音墙。

senses.en: to make a room or building resistant to sound

example.en: They soundproofed the rehearsal space to avoid complaints.
example.zh: 他们给排练室做了隔音，以免招致投诉。

senses.en: a salt or ester formed from sulphuric acid

example.en: Copper sulphate crystals are bright blue.
example.zh: 硫酸铜晶体呈亮蓝色。

senses.en: a strong cotton cloth used to make jeans and other clothes

example.en: The jacket is made of tough blue denim.
example.zh: 这件夹克是用结实的蓝色牛仔布做的。

senses.en: (usually denims) casual trousers made of denim; jeans

example.en: He wore worn denims to the office on Friday.
example.zh: 他周五穿着旧牛仔裤去上班。

senses.en: again, in a new or different way

example.en: After the failure, she decided to start her project anew.
example.zh: 失败之后，她决定重新开始她的项目。

senses.en: a trained group of people who form the core of an organization; a senior official in a party or organization

example.en: The party sent a cadre of organizers to the region.
example.zh: 该党派了一组骨干组织者前往该地区。

senses.en: a small group trained to expand into a larger unit

example.en: A cadre of experienced officers trained the new recruits.
example.zh: 一组经验丰富的骨干军官训练新兵。

senses.en: a rounded part of an organ, such as the lungs or brain

example.en: The tumour was found in the upper lobe of his lung.
example.zh: 肿瘤在他的肺上叶被发现。

senses.en: the soft fleshy part at the bottom of the ear

example.en: She wore small rings in her ear lobes.
example.zh: 她在耳垂上戴了小小的耳环。

senses.en: Strange or unusual in a way that is hard to explain.
senses.zh: 奇怪的；古怪的；难以解释的

example.en: It was odd that nobody answered the door.
example.zh: 没人应门，这很奇怪。

senses.en: Not divisible by two; not even.

example.en: Seven is an odd number.
example.zh: 七是一个奇数。

senses.en: Used about small jobs or tasks that are separate and various.

example.en: He earns extra money by doing odd jobs.
example.zh: 他靠做零工赚外快。

senses.en: A small long-tailed rodent that looks like a large mouse.

example.en: A rat ran along the wall and disappeared into a hole.
example.zh: 一只老鼠沿着墙跑过，消失在一个洞里。

senses.en: An informal word for a person who is regarded as unpleasant or disloyal, especially an informer.

example.en: The thief called the informer a rat.
example.zh: 小偷骂那个告密者是个叛徒。

senses.en: To inform on someone, usually to the police or an authority.

example.en: He refused to rat on his friends.
example.zh: 他拒绝告发朋友。

senses.en: at the same time

example.en: The two alarms sounded simultaneously.
example.zh: 两个警报同时响起。

senses.en: to hold something tightly

example.en: She gripped the railing as the bus turned.
example.zh: 公交车转弯时，她紧抓住栏杆。

senses.en: a firm hold or strong control

example.en: He kept a firm grip on the rope.
example.zh: 他紧紧抓住绳子。

senses.en: the part of an object designed to be held

example.en: The racket has a comfortable grip.
example.zh: 这把球拍的握把很舒适。

senses.en: the act of separating something into parts, or the state of being separated

example.en: The division of the land into small plots took several weeks.
example.zh: 把土地分成小块花了几周时间。

senses.en: a section or department of a larger organization

example.en: She works in the sales division of a large company.
example.zh: 她在一家大公司的销售部门工作。

senses.en: the mathematical operation of splitting a number into equal parts

example.en: In division, you split a number into equal parts.
example.zh: 在除法中，你把一个数分成若干等份。

senses.en: a particular time when something happens

example.en: We met on several occasions last year.
example.zh: 我们去年见过几次面。

senses.en: a special event or celebration

example.en: The wedding was a happy occasion.
example.zh: 那场婚礼是个欢乐的场合。

senses.en: to cause something to happen, especially formally

example.en: His remark occasioned a lively debate.
example.zh: 他的评论引发了一场热烈的辩论。

senses.en: to a very great degree; extremely

example.en: The project has improved our business tremendously.
example.zh: 这个项目极大地改善了我们的业务。

senses.en: a refrigerator, an appliance that keeps food cold

example.en: Put the milk back in the fridge before it goes warm.
example.zh: 趁牛奶还没变温，把它放回冰箱。

senses.en: covered with or full of snow

example.en: We walked through the snowy streets after the storm.
example.zh: 暴风雪过后，我们走过积雪的街道。

senses.en: having a lot of snow or frequent snowfall

example.en: Northern Canada has long snowy winters.
example.zh: 加拿大北部有漫长多雪的冬天。

senses.en: to make someone laugh or smile

example.en: The comedian's jokes amused the whole audience.
example.zh: 这位喜剧演员的笑话逗乐了全场观众。

senses.en: to entertain someone or keep them pleasantly occupied

example.en: She amused herself with a book while waiting.
example.zh: 她等待时用一本书消遣。

senses.en: something that must exist or be done before something else can happen

example.en: A valid passport is a prerequisite for international travel.
example.zh: 有效护照是国际旅行的先决条件。

senses.en: required as a condition before something else can happen
senses.zh: 作为先决条件的；必需的

example.en: Basic math skills are prerequisite for this course.
example.zh: 基础数学技能是这门课程的先修要求。

senses.en: a nobleman of low rank in European countries, or a British peer of the lowest rank

example.en: He was made a baron for his services to the country.
example.zh: 他因对国家的贡献被封为男爵。

senses.en: a powerful businessman who controls a particular industry

example.en: an oil baron
example.zh: 石油大亨

senses.en: fastened in place and not able to move

example.en: The ladder is fixed to the wall.
example.zh: 梯子固定在墙上。

senses.en: not changing or able to be changed

example.en: We pay a fixed rent every month.
example.zh: 我们每个月付固定的租金。

senses.en: arranged in advance and not genuine or fair
senses.zh: 事先安排好的，（比赛等）做手脚的

example.en: The match was suspected to be fixed.
example.zh: 人们怀疑这场比赛被操纵了。

senses.en: covered with dust

example.en: The old books on the shelf were dusty.
example.zh: 书架上的旧书落满了灰尘。

senses.en: the degree to which something is connected to or important for the matter at hand

example.en: Your past experience has little relevance to this job.
example.zh: 你过去的经历与这份工作关联不大。

senses.en: a formal agreement between two groups, countries, or people

example.en: The two countries signed a trade pact last year.
example.zh: 两国去年签署了一项贸易协定。

senses.en: to connect things to each other, or to be connected with each other

example.en: All the computers in the office are interconnected.
example.zh: 办公室里所有的电脑都互相连接。

senses.en: a sport in which players hit a shuttlecock over a net with rackets

example.en: We played badminton in the gym after school.
example.zh: 放学后我们在体育馆打羽毛球。

senses.en: the statistical study of human populations, such as their size, growth, and structure

example.en: Demography helps governments plan for future needs like schools and hospitals.
example.zh: 人口统计学帮助政府规划学校和医院等未来需求。

senses.en: in place of something or someone; as an alternative

example.en: He didn't take the bus; he walked instead.
example.zh: 他没有坐公交车，而是步行前往。

senses.en: used to say what did not happen, contrasting with what did happen

example.en: She expected to feel better, but instead she felt worse.
example.zh: 她原以为会感觉好些，结果反而更糟。

senses.en: all the time or very often; again and again

example.en: She constantly checks her phone during dinner.
example.zh: 她吃饭时总是不停地看手机。

senses.en: without stopping; continuously

example.en: The machine runs constantly, day and night.
example.zh: 这台机器日夜不停地运转。

senses.en: a person who manages or cares for forests

example.en: The forester plants new trees each spring.
example.zh: 这位林务员每年春天种植新树。

senses.en: the quality of being unpleasantly rough or severe

example.en: The prisoners complained about the harshness of their treatment.
example.zh: 囚犯们抱怨所受待遇的苛刻。

senses.en: an unpleasantly rough or grating quality of sound or texture

example.en: Listeners noticed the harshness of his voice after the long speech.
example.zh: 听众注意到他在长篇演讲后嗓音的刺耳。

senses.en: coming after ninety-nine others in order

example.en: She celebrated the hundredth anniversary of the school.
example.zh: 她参加了学校一百周年校庆。

senses.en: one of a hundred equal parts

example.en: The needle moved by less than a hundredth of a millimeter.
example.zh: 指针移动了不到百分之一毫米。

senses.en: a U-shaped pin for holding hair in place

example.en: She fastened her hair with a silver hairpin.
example.zh: 她用一支银发夹把头发固定住。

senses.en: (British, informal) a cigarette

example.en: He went outside for a quick fag.
example.zh: 他出去匆匆抽了一支烟。

senses.en: (British, informal, dated) a tiring or troublesome task
senses.zh: （英，口语，旧用法）苦差事；麻烦事

example.en: Carrying all those boxes up the stairs was a real fag.
example.zh: 把所有那些箱子搬上楼梯真是件苦差事。

senses.en: (dated) to work hard until tired, or to make someone tired

example.en: He fagged away at the report all night.
example.zh: 他整夜辛苦地赶那份报告。

senses.en: (US, offensive) an offensive term for a gay man
senses.zh: （美，冒犯语）对男同性恋者的蔑称

example.en: The guide explains that fag is an offensive slur for a gay man.
example.zh: 指南解释说，fag 是对男同性恋者的冒犯性蔑称。

senses.en: a machine or tool for grinding something into powder or smoothing it

example.en: He sharpened the blade on the grinder.
example.zh: 他在磨床上磨利刀刃。

senses.en: a molar tooth at the back of the mouth used for grinding food

example.en: One of her back grinders was aching.
example.zh: 她后边的一颗臼齿在疼。

senses.en: the hard material that comes from trees and is used for building and making things

example.en: She made a small table from old wood.
example.zh: 她用旧木头做了一张小桌子。

senses.en: a small forest or an area covered with trees

example.en: We walked through the woods after lunch.
example.zh: 午饭后我们穿过树林散步。

senses.en: to deal successfully with a difficult situation

example.en: She coped well with the pressure.
example.zh: 她很好地应对了压力。

senses.en: a long ceremonial cloak worn by some Christian priests
senses.zh: （某些基督教神职人员在仪式上穿的）长披风

example.en: The bishop wore a golden cope.
example.zh: 主教披着一件金色的礼仪披风。

senses.en: the brightness that makes it possible to see things

example.en: The room was full of morning light.
example.zh: 房间里充满了晨光。

senses.en: a lamp or other device that produces light

example.en: She turned on the light in the hallway.
example.zh: 她打开了走廊里的灯。

senses.en: not heavy; easy to lift or carry

example.en: This bag is light enough to carry all day.
example.zh: 这个包很轻，可以背一整天。

senses.en: to make something start to burn

example.en: He lit a candle before dinner.
example.zh: 他在晚饭前点了一支蜡烛。

senses.en: words or ideas that have no meaning or that are silly and absurd
senses.zh: 胡说；无意义的话；荒唐的事

example.en: Stop talking nonsense and answer my question.
example.zh: 别胡说了，回答我的问题。

senses.en: foolish or unacceptable behaviour

example.en: I've had enough of this nonsense—get back to work.
example.zh: 这种胡闹我受够了——回去干活。

senses.en: land covered with grass where farm animals such as cattle and sheep feed

example.en: The cows spend the summer in an open pasture.
example.zh: 牛群夏天在开阔的牧场上度过。

senses.en: to put animals in a field to eat grass

example.en: The farmer pastures his sheep on the hillside.
example.zh: 农夫在山坡上放牧他的羊。

senses.en: to feel or express deep sadness, especially after someone dies

example.en: She mourned the loss of her close friend.
example.zh: 她为挚友的离世而哀悼。

senses.en: to feel sorrow about a loss or change

example.en: Fans mourned the end of their favorite TV show.
example.zh: 粉丝们为喜爱的电视剧完结感到惋惜。

senses.en: a sticky substance used to stick things together

example.en: Use glue to stick the photo into the book.
example.zh: 用胶水把照片粘到书里。

senses.en: to stick things together with glue

example.en: He glued the broken pieces together.
example.zh: 他把碎片粘在了一起。

senses.en: to make information known, especially information that was secret

example.en: The company disclosed its financial results last week.
example.zh: 该公司上周披露了其财务业绩。

senses.en: to reveal or uncover something that was hidden

example.en: Opening the door disclosed a small garden.
example.zh: 打开门露出了一个花园。

senses.en: having the skill or ability to do a job well

example.en: She is a competent engineer who always delivers good work.
example.zh: 她是一位胜任的工程师，工作总是做得很出色。

senses.en: adequate but not outstanding; satisfactory
senses.zh: 尚可的；合格的（但不突出）

example.en: The report was competent, though not particularly impressive.
example.zh: 这份报告还算合格，但并不特别出色。

senses.en: having legal authority or qualification
senses.zh: 有法定资格的；有权（处理）的

example.en: Only a competent court can decide this case.
example.zh: 只有具有管辖权的法院才能审理此案。

senses.en: water that flows over the ground into streams after rain or snowmelt

example.en: Heavy rains caused runoff that flooded the fields.
example.zh: 大雨造成的径流淹没了田地。

senses.en: a second election or race held because the first was inconclusive

example.en: The mayoral race will be decided in a runoff next month.
example.zh: 市长竞选将在下个月的决选中见分晓。

senses.en: a person or organization that is owed money

example.en: The company had to repay all its creditors.
example.zh: 这家公司不得不偿还所有债权人的欠款。

senses.en: the winner of a battle, game, or contest

example.en: The victor was cheered by the crowd.
example.zh: 获胜者受到了人群的欢呼。

senses.en: a person's social or cultural surroundings

example.en: She grew up in an artistic milieu.
example.zh: 她在艺术氛围的环境中长大。

senses.en: to catch someone or something in a trap, or trick them into doing something

example.en: Investigators entrapped no one; the suspect acted entirely on his own.
example.zh: 调查人员没有设套诱捕任何人；嫌疑人完全是自己行动的。

senses.en: something that causes pain or suffering, such as illness or hardship

example.en: He bore his long illness with patience, treating it as a trial rather than merely an affliction.
example.zh: 他耐心地忍受长期的病痛，把它当作考验而非仅仅是苦难。

senses.en: a metal pin used to fasten pieces of metal together

example.en: The workers used rivets to join the steel plates.
example.zh: 工人们用铆钉把钢板连接起来。

senses.en: to fasten something with rivets

example.en: They riveted the metal sheets together.
example.zh: 他们用铆钉把金属板固定在一起。

senses.en: to hold someone's attention completely
senses.zh: 吸引住（注意力）；使目不转睛

example.en: The story riveted everyone in the audience.
example.zh: 这个故事吸引了全场观众。

senses.en: pleasant because it suits your tastes or needs

example.en: They enjoyed a congenial evening by the fire.
example.zh: 他们在炉火旁度过了一个惬意的夜晚。

senses.en: getting along well with others because of shared interests
senses.zh: 意气相投的；志趣相投的

example.en: She found her new colleagues friendly and congenial.
example.zh: 她发现新同事友好且志趣相投。

senses.en: showing that you think you are very important, in an annoying way
senses.zh: 自负的；浮夸的；摆架子的

example.en: He gave a pompous speech full of long words.
example.zh: 他发表了一篇满是冗长词藻的自负演讲。

senses.en: lacking courage or confidence

example.en: The horror movie is not for the fainthearted.
example.zh: 这部恐怖片不适合胆小的人。
